records.rationale: The newly added `addGuestsHandler` awaits `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` with no surrounding timeout/cancellation or bounded retry logic shown in the diff. Since `EventManager` likely performs external calendar provider I/O, this change introduces a concrete risk that the new endpoint can hang indefinitely if a provider call stalls, potentially tying up server resources.
